name: pdk-nibabel-etl
instr:
We're moving the lab's old AFNI archive to NIfTI with nibabel, and a lot of it doesn't come through. Part of the archive is in /data/afni_archive. Several of those datasets won't open with nib.load at all, and the ones that do don't always match what AFNI shows: some have the wrong TR, and nib-convert to .nii.gz changes voxel values.

Every dataset like these should load with nib.load the way AFNI reads it. img.dataobj, read whole or sliced, should give each sub-brick's values with its scale factor applied (complex sub-bricks as complex numbers), and img.get_fdata() should agree for real data. The affine should be the one AFNI uses for the grid (without an IJK_TO_DICOM matrix it comes from ORIGIN and DELTA, which AFNI stores in the dataset's own axis order from ORIENT_SPECIFIC, not in x, y, z order), the voxel sizes in mm and the TR in seconds. A dataset whose BRIK is shorter than its HEAD describes should raise nibabel.brikhead.AFNIImageError when its data is read, and a sub-brick type code AFNI doesn't define should still raise AFNIImageError.

nib-convert from one of these datasets to .nii.gz should keep that affine and those voxel sizes and TR, set the units to mm (and seconds for time series), and keep every voxel within one part in 20000 of the largest absolute value in its sub-brick.
